made_with.scorer: the code the calibration was fitted with (calibration.json readout.tajweed_ref_sha256)
made_with.heads: the whole take of each of model.sampleClips (the session ended, every head), on the CPU engine; the native and the WebAssembly CPU engines give the same bits
made_with.input: model.reference units of the clip's ayah (read from its start to its stop); lengthening entries and geminate letters from quran-tajweed-phonetics joined to those units as /docs/reference shows

tolerance.why: native and WebAssembly CPU engines: 0 difference on every head; an engine in single precision differs by at most 0.00002 nats from one in double precision; the accelerators (Core ML, NPU) differ by tenths of a nat per frame, so the gate runs on the CPU engine
